Definition: something waited for, i.e. confidence (objective or subjective); also a collection, i.e. (of water) a pond, or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove
BiblicalUsage: n m; 1) hope; 1a) hope; 1b) ground of hope; 1c) things hoped for, outcome; 2) collection, collected mass; n pr m; 3) (CLBL) Kue, a place in Cilicia from which Solomon imported horses
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
